entities.summary: International Balkan University (IBU) is a private foundation university established in 2006 in Skopje, the capital of North Macedonia. It was founded by the Foundation for Education and Culture "Üsküp". The university has a 50,000 m² campus and comprises eight faculties, one vocational school, and one language school.
